# Optional inference axioms

These four finite N-Triples tables are derived from the exported axiom constants in OWL-RL 7.6.2, `owlrl/AxiomaticTriples.py`, by Ivan Herman. Duplicate statements were removed and rows sorted; no reasoning code is vendored.

Source: https://github.com/RDFLib/OWL-RL/tree/7.6.2

Source SHA-256: `dcea6c586a5d305ce9e99c1b4832d175cf92e61664cc2320fd25f126bb562cad`.
